en: Potential and act are always simultaneous in terms of chronological

. First of all, we will try to clarify this part of the thesis we have just espoused. Undoubtedly, it does require some explanation. After all, we have often repeated that potential, as such, does not fall

time. So what right do we have suddenly to say that it is simultaneous to the act in a chronologically determinate moment? In order to dispel the impression that we are making a graceless and incoherent about-turn, it is necessary to bring the crucial point to light: namely, that here we are no longer discussing potential ‘as such’, but only its
with a complementary, heterogeneous term. And it is only this hypothetical relationship that is inserted within becoming.
zh: 就年代推进而言，潜能与实现始终同时存在。我们首先要澄清刚刚提出的命题的这一部分。它无疑需要解释。毕竟，我们已经多次重申，潜能本身不落在时间中。那么，我们有什么权利突然说，它在某个年代上确定的时刻同实现同时存在？为了消除我们笨拙而不连贯地掉头的印象，必须把关键点揭示出来：这里不再讨论潜能“本身”，而只讨论它同一个互补而异质的对应项之间的关系。只有这个假设关系被嵌入生成变化。

en: We can speak of temporal
and of chronological
if – and only if – given an indissoluble relationship between two phenomena or concepts, one of the interdependent poles does

fall in time. If they both enjoyed a definite position in the calendar, then the distinction between the two planes would be not just superfluous, but impossible. Yet the relation between what falls in time (the act, the ‘now’) and what does not (potential, the not-now, that which represents the totality of time) is itself also subject to the distinction that it creates and sustains. On the one hand, it is a relation that
, temporalises, and gives structure to becoming; on the other hand, however, it is also a relation that

, has a temporalised pattern, and is itself in becoming. And here it is the second variant that is at play. In what sense, and for what reason, is the correlation between non-actuality and presence fully part of chronological
zh: 当且仅当两个现象或概念之间存在不可分割的关系，而相互依赖的两极之一不落在时间中，我们才能谈论时间秩序与年代推进。如果两极都在日历上占据明确位置，那么两个层面的区分不仅多余，而且不可能。然而，落在时间中的东西——实现、“现在”——同不落在时间中的东西——潜能、非现在、代表时间总体的东西——之间的关系，自身也受它所创造并维持的区分支配。一方面，它是一种安排秩序、使时间化并赋予生成变化以结构的关系；另一方面，它也是一种推进、具有被时间化的模式并且自身处于生成变化中的关系。这里发挥作用的是第二种变体。非现实性与在场之间的关联，在何种意义上、出于什么原因，完全属于年代推进？

en: The connection between potential and act is drawn onto the terrain of chronology, for the simple reason that one of these terms is always dateable. On each occasion, an unrepeatable instant heralds the meeting of the enduring ‘not-now’ with the ephemeral ‘now’: and this instant is the ‘now’ itself. Though potential
does not fall in time, it does nonetheless enter into this or that determinate present

its relation with the act. Obliquely, as an echo, that is. The date pertaining to the word that I am saying is the same as the date in which the bond between this word and the capacity-to-speak is visible: and this date is thus also attached to the capacity-to-speak, even if as a merely transitory property. The faculty adopts a temporalised aspect in a specific moment:
its single execution is underway. Neither before nor afterwards. But if potential enters into the weft of chronology only
the act is taking place – as a result of its relation to that act – then we ought to have no hesitation in concluding that it is always

to the act, from a chronological point of view. Here, the possibility of both appearing in the calendar is wholly the same thing as their specific positioning in the calendar. The only way that potential (a permanent not-now) can be situated in time is for it to be contemporary to the only thing that can indirectly draw it
time: the act (the ephemeral ‘now’).
zh: 潜能与实现之间的联系被纳入时序的范围，理由很简单：两个概念之一始终可以标定日期。每一次，一个不可重复的瞬间都宣告恒久“非现在”与转瞬即逝的“现在”相遇，而这个瞬间就是“现在”本身。潜能自身虽然不落在时间中，却凭借同实现的关系进入这个或那个确定当下；也就是说，以间接方式、以回声的方式进入。我正在说出的词所具有的日期，也正是这个词同言说能力之间的纽带变得可见的日期；因此，这个日期也附着到言说能力上，哪怕只是作为转瞬即逝的属性。官能在一个特定时刻采取被时间化的面貌：就是它的单次实行正在进行之时。既不在此前，也不在此后。但如果潜能只有在实现发生期间，作为它同该实现之关系的结果，才进入年代经纬，那么我们就应毫不犹豫地得出结论：从年代角度看，它始终同实现同时存在。这里，二者都能出现在日历中的可能性，与它们在日历中的特定位置完全是同一回事。潜能——永恒的非现在——位于时间中的唯一方式，就是同唯一能够间接把它拉进时间的东西——实现，转瞬即逝的“现在”——同时存在。

en: The language faculty irrupts into becoming in concomitance with the phrase that I am speaking. It appears precisely now, as I speak, neither before nor afterwards: but, note, right now it appears as something persistent which was already there before and still will be after the fleeting actual utterance. Labour-power is concretely expressed
the realisation of a particular labour: yet, in that transient moment, labour-power is
experienced as permanent and unchanging. The perceptible context that we call ‘the world’ appears in relation to a determinate fact, in perfect

with it: but even then it appears as the perennial backdrop to any conceivable fact. To make one first, almost obvious observation: the things that coexist, here, are not two different temporalised states of affairs, but rather the temporal dimensions of ‘always’ and ‘now’ themselves. In sum, we are here dealing with the

children: simultaneity of the permanent and the changeable

en: , of time-as-a-whole and a specific position in time, as Kant mentions in his ‘Preface’ to the
. A second, less obvious observation: in chronological progression, the ‘always’ depends on the ‘now’, and is its echo or corollary. The permanent exists in function of the changeable:
change is taking place and
it taking place. Indeed, the permanent is only

. It has nothing in common with the eternal presence of a substance. Because it is radically non-actual, the permanent (the language faculty, labour-power, etc.) needs a fleeting presence (the utterance to which I give voice, the work to which I dedicate myself) in order to latch on to time. The dependence of the ‘always’ on the ‘now’ explains the touching, even heartrending character of each given ‘now’. Each act is full of pathos because it allows us to glimpse for a brief second the enduring potential that accompanies it.
zh: 语言官能同我正在说出的句子一道闯入生成变化。它恰恰在我言说的这个现在出现，不早也不晚；但请注意，它此刻作为一种持久之物出现，在短暂的现实话语之前已经存在，在话语之后仍将存在。劳动力在某项特定劳动得到实行期间具体表达出来；然而就在那个转瞬即逝的时刻，劳动力被经验为恒久不变。我们称为“世界”的可感语境在同某个确定事实发生关系时，与事实完全同步地出现；但即使在这时，它也作为任何可以想象之事实的永恒背景出现。先作第一项几乎显而易见的观察：这里共存的不是两种不同的被时间化事态，而正是“始终”与“现在”这两个时间维度本身。简言之，我们处理的是康德在《纯粹理性批判》“序言”中提到的恒久与变化、作为整体的时间与时间中某个具体位置的同时性。第二项不那么明显的观察是：在年代推进中，“始终”依赖“现在”，是它的回声或推论。恒久之物依存于变化之物：在变化发生时、并且由于变化发生而存在。事实上，恒久之物只是潜在的，同实体的永恒在场没有任何共同之处。恒久之物——语言官能、劳动力，等等——由于根本不处于现实态，需要一个转瞬即逝的在场——我发声说出的话语、我投身其中的劳动——才能扣住时间。“始终”对“现在”的依赖，解释了每个既定“现在”为什么令人感动，甚至令人心碎。每项实现都充满情感张力，因为它使我们短暂一瞬瞥见伴随它的恒久潜能。

en: As we know, Aristotle devoted himself to refuting the simultaneity of potential and act, which Euclid of Megara’s disciples had insisted upon with the declared goal of eliminating any difference between the two terms.
He wrote: ‘There are some who say, as the

Megaric school does, that a thing “can” act only when it is acting, and when it is not acting it “cannot” act, e.g. that he who is not building cannot build, but only he who is building, when he is building; and so in all other cases. It is not hard to see the absurdities that attend this view.’
In order to pull apart the Megaric pretence of ‘mak[ing] potency and actuality the same’,
Aristotle made use of a chronological scansion: potential

the act in the flow of time (if we limit ourselves to observing a single being). But it should be understood that simultaneity does not necessarily imply identity. Perhaps, on the contrary, it is only their simultaneity that fully preserves the separation between potential and actual being. In effect, in the last few pages we have already introduced an
conception of simultaneity. All that remains is to emphasise its salient traits, such as to shake off at least the most basic misunderstandings.
zh: 众所周知，麦加拉的欧几里得的弟子坚持潜能与实现同时存在，公开目标是消除两个概念之间的一切差别；亚里士多德致力于驳斥这种观点。
他写道：“有些人像麦加拉学派那样主张，一个事物只有正在活动时才‘能够’活动，不活动时就‘不能’活动；例如，没有正在建造的人不能建造，只有正在建造的人在建造时才能建造；其他情形也一样。不难看出这种观点造成的荒谬。”
为了拆散麦加拉学派“使潜能与现实性成为同一”
的企图，亚里士多德采用年代分节：如果只观察单个存在者，潜能在时间流动中先于实现。但应当明白，同时性并不必然意味着同一。或许恰恰只有二者的同时性，才能充分保存潜在存在与现实存在之间的分离。实际上，过去几页已经引入一种反麦加拉式的同时性观。现在只需强调它的显著特征，以摆脱至少最基本的误解。

en: ‘Potential exists only in the presence of the act’: this assertion, which Aristotle opposed, is perspicacious and possible to share – if we add a little extra clause, namely, ‘in time’. Potential exists
only in the presence of the act: the language faculty is dateable only

an utterance is taking place. Far from blunting or cancelling out the difference between potential and act, their simultaneity is a decisive expression of this difference. The never-actual faculty falls
time only because (and in the moment in which) it is correlated to its wholly

heterogeneous opposite: its execution, which, conversely, coincides with a calculable ‘now’. It goes without saying that potential does still exist even in the absence of the act: but, in this case, it is devoid of any date and extraneous to the progression of chronology. By itself, potential is analogous to the time-as-a-whole within which each succession and simultaneity is positioned. Think, for example, of labour-power. In separation from the actual fulfilment of a particular piece of work, the generic psycho-physical disposition to produce is nothing but an

children: empirical image of the totality of time

en: . It is in this guise, moreover, that the ‘potential to build’ plays a decisive role in political economy. The fulcrum of the capitalist accumulation process resides in the buying and selling of labour-power as a pure, still-unapplied faculty – that is to say, the buying and selling of time in general, the backdrop to and presupposition of the consecutive ‘nows’ in which the performance of labour will be articulated.
zh: “潜能只有在实现在场时才存在”：亚里士多德所反对的这句话既敏锐又可以赞同——只要加上一个小小限定：“在时间中”。潜能只有在实现在场时才存在于时间中：语言官能只有在一段话语正在发生时才能标定日期。二者的同时性非但没有削弱或取消潜能与实现的差别，反而是这个差别的决定性表达。从未成为现实态的官能之所以落入时间，只因为——也只在——它同自己完全异质的对立面发生关联；这个对立面就是它的实行，而实行反过来同一个可计算的“现在”重合。不言而喻，即使没有实现，潜能仍然存在；但在这种情形中，它没有任何日期，外在于年代推进。潜能本身类似于一切接续和同时性被定位于其中的作为整体之时间。例如可以想想劳动力。脱离某项具体劳动的实际完成，一般生产身心禀赋不过是时间总体的一幅经验影像。此外，“建造潜能”正是以这种形态在政治经济学中发挥决定性作用。资本主义积累过程的枢轴，是买卖作为纯粹而尚未应用之官能的劳动力；也就是说，买卖一般时间，买卖那些劳动表现将在其中得到分节的连续“现在”之背景和预设。

en: Potential exists
only in the presence of the act. But
does potential exist in time together with the act? What happens, exactly, in the ‘when’ common to the two of them? How do these two simultaneous elements interact? We have already seen that the act

realise potential, but contradicts it and puts it on notice. The form of concomitance is that of an opposition: the ‘now’ clashes with the not-now, the specific execution contravenes the perpetual latency of the faculty, the word spoken breaks with the amorphous and undifferentiated capacity-to-speak. The date that the potential obliquely takes on – by virtue of its relation to a determinate act – is the date of its
by that same act. In the chronological field, the permanent appears as that which the changeable is
contravening. We are
quite at odds, then, with the symbiotic juxtaposition for which the Megarians wished and Aristotle dreaded.
zh: 潜能只有在实现在场时才存在于时间中。但是，潜能以何种方式同实现一起存在于时间？二者共有的“当……时”中究竟发生什么？这两个同时存在的要素如何相互作用？我们已经看到，实现并不实现潜能，而是否定它并向它发出通牒。并存采取对立的形式：“现在”同非现在冲突；具体实行打破官能恒久的潜伏状态；说出的词同无形式、未分化的言说能力决裂。潜能凭借同某项确定实现的关系而间接取得日期；这个日期就是潜能被同一实现否定的日期。在年代领域，恒久之物作为变化之物此刻正在否定的东西出现。因此，我们同麦加拉学派所希望、而亚里士多德所畏惧的共生并置相去甚远。

en: Let us think about it the other way around. In order to exclude their simultaneity, we would have to assume: a) that potential, already and on its own account, falls

time; b) that potential is equivalent to a ‘potential act’, in principle already on its way to realisation. Well, it is these very suppositions, which are interlinked and mutually supportive, that destroy at root the difference in nature between potential and act. Or better, they convert it into a simple difference of degree on the same homogeneous scale: if it is the same thing as a potential act, then potential seems like a poor imitation of the real act; inscribed in the calendar, the not-now is reduced to an almost-now, which is always commensurable to the ‘now’ that it prefigures. Thus the gap between non-actuality and presence, which characterises each single moment of becoming, disappears. The attack levelled against the chronological concomitance of potential and act is thus now turned against its alternative: if the faculty had a date different from that of the execution, then the essential heterogeneity between them would be lesser. Ultimately, to deny their simultaneity fatally leads to the loss of the distinction between them.
zh: 让我们反过来思考。若要排除潜能与实现同时存在，就必须假定：（a）潜能已经凭自身落入时间；（b）潜能等同于“潜在实现”，原则上已经走上实现之路。然而，正是这两个彼此连接、相互支撑的假定，从根本上摧毁了潜能与实现之间性质上的差别。更准确地说，它们把这种差别转化成同一个同质尺度上的简单程度差别：潜能如果等同于潜在实现，就显得是现实实现的拙劣摹本；非现在一旦被铭写进日历，就被还原成一个近似现在，始终可以同它所预示的“现在”通约。于是，构成每个生成时刻之特征的非现实性与在场之间的裂隙消失了。过去针对潜能与实现在年代上并存的攻击，现在反过来击中它的替代方案：如果官能具有一个不同于实行的日期，二者本质上的异质性反而会减弱。归根结底，否认二者同时存在，注定会使我们失去二者之间的区分。

参见卢恰诺·蒙托内里，《麦加拉学派：历史批判研究与证言翻译》（I Megarici. Studio storico-critico e traduzione delle testimonianze），卡塔尼亚：卡塔尼亚大学，1984年；以及雅科·欣蒂卡，《时间与必然性：亚里士多德模态理论研究》（Time and Necessity: Studies in Aristotle’s Theory of Modality），牛津：克拉伦登出版社，1973年，尤其第9章‘亚里士多德与狄奥多罗斯的“主论证”’。
